queries.signature: HANDLE WINAPI OpenJobObjectW(DWORD desired_access, BOOL inherit_handle, LPCWSTR exact_name)
queries.fact: The existing named Job is opened subject to its DACL; names are case-sensitive. Success returns a handle with the requested rights, failure returns null. No association or setting is changed.
QUERY0x0004 covers relevant queries and IsProcessInJob. ASSIGN0x0001 and TERMINATE0x0008 are different rights and are not required by this observer.

queries.signature: BOOL WINAPI IsProcessInJob(HANDLE held_process, HANDLE exact_job, PBOOL result)
queries.fact: Use the original held process and a non-null exact Job handle. Record function success separately from result. On API failure result is not a qualified negative; preserve null/unknown and immediate error.

Close the newly opened query handle once. A failed or unknown close blocks resource qualification. Closing a process handle does not terminate that process; it is not a replacement for crash supervision.

required_observer_boundaries: Bind exact named outer Job to the original guarded config and original owner-held lifetime; never use a null Job or any-Job query as the exact result.
Bracket by held process PID/generation/image readbacks and original QPC bounds, with no actor resume or new allowance.
Retain two independent query outcomes, even if the first is false, before applying the original both-true admission gate.
Scope the temporary query handle in a separate once ledger and aggregate uncertainty into cleanup; do not retain closed numeric values in the long-lived process/token ledger.
No OpenJob failure fallback to broader rights, another name, another Job, post-create AssignProcessToJobObject or process lookup by unbound PID.
The source03 observer does not itself prove CPSE preserves Job attributes or establish caller-crash cleanup for an out-of-Job process.
